Believes hardship is fuel — 'pressure makes diamonds', the 2009 foreclosure was 'the best thing that ever happened' to him

Says he's a 'get-it-done family' guy, not a 'talk-about-it' guy, and is proud of 'moving in silence'
Frames everything through God's plan / seasons / alignment and says he's genuinely grateful and blessed

latent_self.claim: He metabolizes emotional crises by converting them into logistics and payments, and is reliably absent from the ritual/presence part — the funeral, the visit, the room.
latent_self.how_it_shows: At 11 he numbers 41 boxes and makes an inventory while the family collapses; he books his girlfriend's sister's flight, fights the florist and pays for the funeral luncheon from Cabo but never attends; he autopays $4,800/month for his brother's rehab and has never driven the 100 minutes to see him.

latent_self.claim: He is the hidden financial spine of his whole family and deliberately conceals it, reframing every act of support as personal ambition or 'just what you do' — he gets visibly uncomfortable and changes the subject whenever the money-for-others comes up.
latent_self.how_it_shows: The $312 car payment for 26 months he 'doesn't count'; 'I never told anybody that, I'm not saying it for whatever'; the rehab bill he 'doesn't even look at'; the four-bedroom house bought for a mother who won't move in.

latent_self.claim: His real gift and his real tenderness is with isolated old people, and he'll do unpaid, unglamorous domestic tasks for them for hours — the opposite of the aggressive closer identity he sells.
latent_self.how_it_shows: Grandma Elva's swamp cooler and bigger food portions remembered with love; six hours with Mrs. Delgado, buying AC filters and moving her box fan; Sunday crosswords and glass-bottle Cokes at memory care; driving out to 91-year-old Ray whose inverter is fine.

latent_self.claim: He will not confront or expose a person in authority or a person he loves — he silently repairs the damage downstream and hands the judgment off to 'God' or fate instead of ever naming the wrong.
latent_self.how_it_shows: Lets his parents believe he's enrolled for a year rather than 'bring the energy in the house'; fixes Mrs. Delgado's forged contract over 11 weeks but never reports the fraud and still calls Big Mike a genius; never tells Kayla he's choosing Cabo over her father's funeral and leans on 'she never asked me to come'.

latent_self.claim: Lifelong insomnia that he has rebranded as discipline, paired with compulsive precise counting (doors, dollars, boxes, views, months) as a self-soothing ritual — the numbers are always exact even when the feelings are vague.
latent_self.how_it_shows: Forty-one boxes and twelve skinny-Sharpie ones; $312 for 26 months; 94-110 doors logged in Notes he's never deleted; 'awake at 2:15 anyway, never have slept great, since I was a kid'; 284,000 views, 11,200 followers, 112 accounts.

decoys.claim: He's a money-obsessed narcissist chasing status and toys.
decoys.why_false: Nearly all the money leaves him — car payments, a funeral luncheon, a dog's dental work, a $4,800/month rehab bill, a house bought for a mother who won't live in it; he lives in three empty rooms.

decoys.claim: He's a devout Christian and faith is central to his life.
decoys.why_false: 'God's plan' is pure syntax and a way to outsource judgment; there is no church, no prayer, no congregation anywhere in his life — the only Sunday ritual is a nursing home crossword.

decoys.claim: He's an ex-athlete whose identity was built in sports and whose competitiveness comes from the field.
decoys.why_false: The only sports content is watching the 2009 Cardinals on his grandmother's carpet; his competitiveness was learned on a call-center floor from a four-foot-eleven manager named Renee.

decoys.claim: He dropped out of ASU because he's anti-intellectual and hates school.
decoys.why_false: He was failing because he worked 5pm-1am to cover his mother's car note, and he still lights up talking about a geology lecture on the Superstition caldera.

decoys.claim: He wants to be an influencer and the content is a monetization play.
decoys.why_false: 11k followers, no course, never earned a dollar from it; the posting is what he does at 4am because he can't sleep.

domain_predictions.claim: Despite high income he has almost no savings or retirement of his own and no clear picture of his net worth; his accounts are structured as a pass-through of autopays for other people, he'll drive an aging truck while spending freely on gifts and other people's emergencies, and he avoids opening statements or talking to a financial advisor.

He treats his body as a machine to be logged rather than cared for — meticulous macro/step/workout tracking, energy drinks and skipped meals, chronic 4-5 hours of broken sleep he's proud of, and years of avoiding doctors and dentists; he will only see a physician when a symptom becomes a logistics problem he can schedule.

Essentially all his current friends are downline, teammates or people from the industry, organized around group chats and shared goals; he has let every pre-22 friendship lapse without any rupture, and he's the friend who shows up with a truck, a loan or a ride to the airport but not the one who sits with you in a hospital waiting room.
